note: Pillow, the maintained fork of PIL, does not use ImageMagick: it has its own C imaging core built on libraries such as libjpeg, zlib, libtiff and FreeType. ImageMagick is a separate library, used from Python through Wand. Recommending PIL/Pillow for generating images is still sound.
